description: One Cloudflare Worker serves the SPA and a Hono API under /api (run_worker_first), with security headers on API responses, Worker tests in workerd and generated Env types.
wranglerNotes: The Worker (src/worker) answers /api/* first; every other path is a static asset, and
unknown paths get index.html so client routes work on reload. Never put private files in
public/: they would be served to anyone.

boundaries: API routes live in `src/worker/routes/` under `/api`. Types shared with the client go in `src/shared/`.
Secrets go in `.dev.vars` locally and `wrangler secret put` when deployed. Never in `wrangler.jsonc` `vars`, a `PUBLIC_*` variable or the client bundle.
pitfalls: After changing bindings in `wrangler.jsonc`, run `pnpm types:worker`; `pnpm typecheck` fails until `worker-configuration.d.ts` matches.
